subject.title: fix(plugins): clone registration record metadata for transactional rollback isolation

question: Should this PR be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106647, or should maintainers prefer the overlapping implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108143?
rationale: Both PRs are open, proof-positive, and now cover the active-record gap; selecting one landing path avoids duplicate implementations and conflicting clone semantics.

options.title: Land this PR
options.body: Use this PR's targeted record cloning, which covers all three production callers and deliberately preserves opaque plain and class-backed runtime values by reference.

options.title: Prefer the competing PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108143 if its broader envelope-cloning implementation or production-loader regression coverage is judged materially safer.

options.title: Consolidate unique coverage
options.body: Adopt any uniquely valuable real-loader regression coverage into the preferred branch, then close the other candidate without merging duplicate runtime implementations.

recommendation.title: Land this PR
recommendation.body: Use this PR's targeted record cloning, which covers all three production callers and deliberately preserves opaque plain and class-backed runtime values by reference.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the centralized transaction boundary and are the strongest history-backed owner for choosing its canonical rollback semantics.
